issuer: National People's Congress Standing Committee, on the State Taxation Administration policy database
document: Tax Collection and Administration Law, art. 32
quote: 纳税人未按照规定期限缴纳税款的，扣缴义务人未按照规定期限解缴税款的，税务机关除责令限期缴纳外，从滞纳税款之日起，按日加收滞纳税款万分之五的滞纳金。
plain_english_ours: Tax not paid by the deadline carries a surcharge of 0.05% of the late tax per day, from the day it became late.

issuer: National People's Congress Standing Committee, on the State Taxation Administration policy database
document: Tax Collection and Administration Law, art. 44
quote: 欠缴税款的纳税人或者他的法定代表人需要出境的，应当在出境前向税务机关结清应纳税款、滞纳金或者提供担保。未结清税款、滞纳金，又不提供担保的，税务机关可以通知出境管理机关阻止其出境。
plain_english_ours: A taxpayer who owes tax must settle the tax and surcharge, or give a guarantee, before leaving the country; otherwise the tax office may ask the exit authority to stop the departure.

issuer: National People's Congress Standing Committee, on the State Taxation Administration policy database
document: Tax Collection and Administration Law, art. 52
quote: 因税务机关的责任，致使纳税人、扣缴义务人未缴或者少缴税款的，税务机关在三年内可以要求纳税人、扣缴义务人补缴税款，但是不得加收滞纳金。因纳税人、扣缴义务人计算错误等失误，未缴或者少缴税款的，税务机关在三年内可以追征税款、滞纳金；有特殊情况的，追征期可以延长到五年。对偷税、抗税、骗税的，税务机关追征其未缴或者少缴的税款、滞纳金或者所骗取的税款，不受前款规定期限的限制。
plain_english_ours: Shortfall caused by the tax office: tax may be recovered for three years, with no surcharge. Shortfall caused by the taxpayer's calculation mistake: tax and surcharge for three years, five in special circumstances. Evasion, resistance or fraud: no time limit.

issuer: National People's Congress Standing Committee, on the State Taxation Administration policy database
document: Tax Collection and Administration Law, art. 62
quote: 纳税人未按照规定的期限办理纳税申报和报送纳税资料的，或者扣缴义务人未按照规定的期限向税务机关报送代扣代缴、代收代缴税款报告表和有关资料的，由税务机关责令限期改正，可以处二千元以下的罚款；情节严重的，可以处二千元以上一万元以下的罚款。
plain_english_ours: Filing late: an order to correct and a possible fine of up to RMB 2,000, or RMB 2,000 to 10,000 in serious cases.

issuer: National People's Congress Standing Committee, on the State Taxation Administration policy database
document: Tax Collection and Administration Law, art. 63, first paragraph
quote: 纳税人伪造、变造、隐匿、擅自销毁帐簿、记帐凭证，或者在帐簿上多列支出或者不列、少列收入，或者经税务机关通知申报而拒不申报或者进行虚假的纳税申报，不缴或者少缴应纳税款的，是偷税。对纳税人偷税的，由税务机关追缴其不缴或者少缴的税款、滞纳金，并处不缴或者少缴的税款百分之五十以上五倍以下的罚款；构成犯罪的，依法追究刑事责任。
plain_english_ours: Evasion is forging, altering, hiding or destroying records, overstating expenses or leaving out income, refusing to file after the tax office's notice, or filing a false return. The tax office recovers the tax and surcharge and adds a fine of 50% to five times the unpaid tax; crimes are prosecuted.

issuer: National People's Congress Standing Committee, on the State Taxation Administration policy database
document: Tax Collection and Administration Law, art. 64, second paragraph
quote: 纳税人不进行纳税申报，不缴或者少缴应纳税款的，由税务机关追缴其不缴或者少缴的税款、滞纳金，并处不缴或者少缴的税款百分之五十以上五倍以下的罚款。
plain_english_ours: A taxpayer who does not file and so does not pay: the tax office recovers the tax and surcharge and adds a fine of 50% to five times the unpaid tax.

issuer: National People's Congress Standing Committee, on the State Taxation Administration policy database
document: Tax Collection and Administration Law, art. 68
quote: 纳税人、扣缴义务人在规定期限内不缴或者少缴应纳或者应解缴的税款，经税务机关责令限期缴纳，逾期仍未缴纳的，税务机关除依照本法第四十条的规定采取强制执行措施追缴其不缴或者少缴的税款外，可以处不缴或者少缴的税款百分之五十以上五倍以下的罚款。
plain_english_ours: Tax still unpaid after the tax office's order: enforced collection and a possible fine of 50% to five times the unpaid tax.

issuer: National People's Congress Standing Committee, on the State Taxation Administration policy database
document: Tax Collection and Administration Law, art. 69
quote: 扣缴义务人应扣未扣、应收而不收税款的，由税务机关向纳税人追缴税款，对扣缴义务人处应扣未扣、应收未收税款百分之五十以上三倍以下的罚款。
plain_english_ours: Where the withholding agent failed to withhold, the tax office recovers the tax from the taxpayer and fines the withholding agent 50% to three times the tax.

issuer: National People's Congress Standing Committee, on the State Taxation Administration policy database
document: Tax Collection and Administration Law, art. 86
quote: 违反税收法律、行政法规应当给予行政处罚的行为，在五年内未被发现的，不再给予行政处罚。
plain_english_ours: A violation that should be punished is no longer punished if it was not discovered within five years.

issuer: National People's Congress Standing Committee, on the State Taxation Administration policy database
document: Tax Collection and Administration Law, art. 88, first paragraph
quote: 纳税人、扣缴义务人、纳税担保人同税务机关在纳税上发生争议时，必须先依照税务机关的纳税决定缴纳或者解缴税款及滞纳金或者提供相应的担保，然后可以依法申请行政复议；对行政复议决定不服的，可以依法向人民法院起诉。
plain_english_ours: In a dispute over tax, the taxpayer must first pay the tax and surcharge or give a guarantee, and may then apply for administrative review, and after that sue.

issuer: State Council, on the State Taxation Administration policy database
document: Implementing Rules of the Tax Collection and Administration Law, art. 74
quote: 欠缴税款的纳税人或者其法定代表人在出境前未按照规定结清应纳税款、滞纳金或者提供纳税担保的，税务机关可以通知出入境管理机关阻止其出境。阻止出境的具体办法，由国家税务总局会同公安部制定。
plain_english_ours: If tax and surcharge are not settled or guaranteed before departure, the tax office may notify the exit-entry authority to stop the departure.

issuer: State Council, on the State Taxation Administration policy database
document: Implementing Rules of the Tax Collection and Administration Law, art. 75
quote: 税收征管法第三十二条规定的加收滞纳金的起止时间，为法律、行政法规规定或者税务机关依照法律、行政法规的规定确定的税款缴纳期限届满次日起至纳税人、扣缴义务人实际缴纳或者解缴税款之日止。
plain_english_ours: The surcharge runs from the day after the payment deadline to the day the tax is actually paid.

issuer: State Council, on the State Taxation Administration policy database
document: Implementing Rules of the Tax Collection and Administration Law, art. 80
quote: 税收征管法第五十二条所称税务机关的责任，是指税务机关适用税收法律、行政法规不当或者执法行为违法。
plain_english_ours: 'The tax office's responsibility' means the office applied the law wrongly or enforced it unlawfully.

issuer: State Council, on the State Taxation Administration policy database
document: Implementing Rules of the Tax Collection and Administration Law, art. 81
quote: 税收征管法第五十二条所称纳税人、扣缴义务人计算错误等失误，是指非主观故意的计算公式运用错误以及明显的笔误。
plain_english_ours: 'Calculation mistakes' means unintended misuse of a formula and obvious clerical errors.

issuer: State Council, on the State Taxation Administration policy database
document: Implementing Rules of the Tax Collection and Administration Law, art. 82
quote: 税收征管法第五十二条所称特殊情况，是指纳税人或者扣缴义务人因计算错误等失误，未缴或者少缴、未扣或者少扣、未收或者少收税款，累计数额在１０万元以上的。
plain_english_ours: 'Special circumstances' means a shortfall from calculation mistakes that adds up to RMB 100,000 or more.

issuer: State Council, on the State Taxation Administration policy database
document: Implementing Rules of the Tax Collection and Administration Law, art. 83
quote: 税收征管法第五十二条规定的补缴和追征税款、滞纳金的期限，自纳税人、扣缴义务人应缴未缴或者少缴税款之日起计算。
plain_english_ours: The recovery periods in art. 52 are counted from the day the tax should have been paid.

issuer: State Taxation Administration
document: Reply on the recovery period for undeclared tax, Guo Shui Han [2009] No. 326
quote: 税收征管法第六十四条第二款规定的纳税人不进行纳税申报造成不缴或少缴应纳税款的情形不属于偷税、抗税、骗税，其追征期按照税收征管法第五十二条规定的精神，一般为三年，特殊情况可以延长至五年。
plain_english_ours: Not filing, as described in art. 64 paragraph 2, is not evasion, resistance or fraud; its recovery period follows the spirit of art. 52: generally three years, up to five in special circumstances.

issuer: National People's Congress Standing Committee, on the State Taxation Administration site
document: Individual Income Tax Law (2018), art. 2
quote: 下列各项个人所得，应当缴纳个人所得税：（一）工资、薪金所得；（二）劳务报酬所得；（三）稿酬所得；（四）特许权使用费所得；（五）经营所得；（六）利息、股息、红利所得；（七）财产租赁所得；（八）财产转让所得；（九）偶然所得。
plain_english_ours: Nine kinds of income are taxed: wages; fees for services; author's fees; royalties; business income; interest and dividends; rent; gains on selling property; incidental income.

issuer: National People's Congress Standing Committee, on the State Taxation Administration site
document: Individual Income Tax Law (2018), art. 3
quote: （一）综合所得，适用百分之三至百分之四十五的超额累进税率（税率表附后）；（二）经营所得，适用百分之五至百分之三十五的超额累进税率（税率表附后）；（三）利息、股息、红利所得，财产租赁所得，财产转让所得和偶然所得，适用比例税率，税率为百分之二十。
plain_english_ours: Wages and fees taken together: 3% to 45% progressive. Business income: 5% to 35% progressive. Interest, dividends, rent, property gains and incidental income: a flat 20%.

issuer: National People's Congress Standing Committee, on the State Taxation Administration site
document: Individual Income Tax Law (2018), art. 6
quote: （一）居民个人的综合所得，以每一纳税年度的收入额减除费用六万元以及专项扣除、专项附加扣除和依法确定的其他扣除后的余额，为应纳税所得额。 […] （四）财产租赁所得，每次收入不超过四千元的，减除费用八百元；四千元以上的，减除百分之二十的费用，其余额为应纳税所得额。（五）财产转让所得，以转让财产的收入额减除财产原值和合理费用后的余额，为应纳税所得额。（六）利息、股息、红利所得和偶然所得，以每次收入额为应纳税所得额。
plain_english_ours: A resident's yearly wages and fees are taxed after deducting RMB 60,000 and the other allowed deductions. Rent: deduct RMB 800 if the payment is RMB 4,000 or less, otherwise 20%. Property sale: proceeds minus original cost and reasonable expenses. Interest, dividends and incidental income: the full amount of each payment.

issuer: National People's Congress Standing Committee, on the State Taxation Administration site
document: Individual Income Tax Law (2018), art. 9
quote: 个人所得税以所得人为纳税人，以支付所得的单位或者个人为扣缴义务人。
plain_english_ours: The person who receives the income is the taxpayer; the organisation or person who pays it is the withholding agent.

issuer: National People's Congress Standing Committee, on the State Taxation Administration site
document: Individual Income Tax Law (2018), art. 10
quote: 有下列情形之一的，纳税人应当依法办理纳税申报： […] （二）取得应税所得没有扣缴义务人；（三）取得应税所得，扣缴义务人未扣缴税款；
plain_english_ours: The taxpayer must file a return when taxable income had no withholding agent, or when the withholding agent did not withhold.

issuer: National People's Congress Standing Committee, on the State Taxation Administration site
document: Individual Income Tax Law (2018), art. 13
quote: 纳税人取得应税所得没有扣缴义务人的，应当在取得所得的次月十五日内向税务机关报送纳税申报表，并缴纳税款。纳税人取得应税所得，扣缴义务人未扣缴税款的，纳税人应当在取得所得的次年六月三十日前，缴纳税款；税务机关通知限期缴纳的，纳税人应当按照期限缴纳税款。
plain_english_ours: No withholding agent: file and pay within the first 15 days of the following month. Withholding agent did not withhold: pay by 30 June of the following year, or by the date in the tax office's notice.

issuer: National People's Congress (npc.gov.cn)
document: Individual Income Tax Law (2018), Rate Table 1, text version
quote: 个人所得税税率表一（综合所得适用）级数 · 全年应纳税所得额 · 税率（％） 1 · 不超过36000元的 · 3 2 · 超过36000元至144000元的部分 · 10 3 · 超过144000元至300000元的部分 · 20 4 · 超过300000元至420000元的部分 · 25 5 · 超过420000元至660000元的部分 · 30 6 · 超过660000元至960000元的部分 · 35 7 · 超过960000元的部分 · 45
plain_english_ours: Yearly taxable income: up to 36,000 at 3%; 36,000 to 144,000 at 10%; to 300,000 at 20%; to 420,000 at 25%; to 660,000 at 30%; to 960,000 at 35%; above 960,000 at 45%. On the tax administration's own page this table is an image, so the text was taken from the legislature's page.

issuer: National People's Congress Standing Committee, on the State Taxation Administration policy database
document: Criminal Law Amendment (VII), item 3, which sets the text of Criminal Law art. 201
quote: 纳税人采取欺骗、隐瞒手段进行虚假纳税申报或者不申报，逃避缴纳税款数额较大并且占应纳税额百分之十以上的，处三年以下有期徒刑或者拘役，并处罚金；数额巨大并且占应纳税额百分之三十以上的，处三年以上七年以下有期徒刑，并处罚金。 […] 有第一款行为，经税务机关依法下达追缴通知后，补缴应纳税款，缴纳滞纳金，已受行政处罚的，不予追究刑事责任；但是，五年内因逃避缴纳税款受过刑事处罚或者被税务机关给予二次以上行政处罚的除外。
plain_english_ours: Evading a relatively large amount that is 10% or more of the tax due: up to three years' imprisonment and a fine. A huge amount that is 30% or more: three to seven years. No criminal liability if, after the tax office's recovery notice, the person pays the tax and surcharge and has received the administrative penalty, unless convicted of evasion or administratively punished twice or more for it within five years.

issuer: National People's Congress Standing Committee, published by the National Bureau of Statistics
document: Administrative Compulsion Law, art. 45
quote: 加处罚款或者滞纳金的数额不得超出金钱给付义务的数额。
plain_english_ours: Added fines or surcharges may not exceed the amount of the payment obligation itself.

issuer: State Taxation Administration, as republished in the Ministry of Commerce policy database
document: Reply on individual income tax a government body failed to withhold, Guo Shui Han [2004] No. 1199, item 3
quote: 按照《征管法》规定的原则，扣缴义务人应扣未扣税款，无论适用修订前还是修订后的《征管法》，均不得向纳税人或扣缴义务人加收滞纳金。
plain_english_ours: Where a withholding agent failed to withhold, no surcharge may be charged to the taxpayer or to the withholding agent, under either version of the collection law.

issuer: State Taxation Administration
document: Announcement [2018] No. 55: the Tax Payment Record (纳税记录) replaces the paper tax certificate
quote: 纳税人2019年1月1日以后取得应税所得并由扣缴义务人向税务机关办理了全员全额扣缴申报，或根据税法规定自行向税务机关办理纳税申报的，不论是否实际缴纳税款，均可以申请开具《纳税记录》。 […] 纳税人可以通过电子税务局、手机APP申请开具本人的个人所得税《纳税记录》，也可到办税服务厅申请开具。
plain_english_ours: For income from 1 January 2019 that was reported by the withholding agent or declared by the taxpayer, a Tax Payment Record can be issued whether or not tax was actually paid. It is issued through the electronic tax bureau, the mobile app, or a tax service hall.

issuer: State Taxation Administration
document: Announcement [2018] No. 55, item 1, on the State Taxation Administration site
quote: 纳税人申请开具税款所属期为2018年12月31日（含）以前个人所得税缴（退）税情况证明的，税务机关继续开具《税收完税证明》（文书式）。
plain_english_ours: For tax periods up to 31 December 2018 the tax office still issues the older paper Tax Payment Certificate (税收完税证明).

issuer: State Administration of Foreign Exchange, Tianjin branch
document: Personal foreign exchange Q&A (08), 13 July 2026, quoting art. 59 of the 2020 Current Account Guidelines
quote: 境外个人在境内取得的经常项目合法人民币收入，凭本人有效身份证件和有交易额的购汇资金来源材料（含税务凭证）在银行办理购汇
plain_english_ours: A foreign individual buys foreign currency at a bank for lawful RMB current-account income earned in China with valid ID and documents showing the source of the funds and the amount, including tax evidence.

issuer: Ministry of Finance and State Taxation Administration
document: Cai Shui [2008] No. 132 on savings-deposit interest
quote: 自2008年10月9日起，对储蓄存款利息所得暂免征收个人所得税。
plain_english_ours: From 9 October 2008, individual income tax on savings-deposit interest is temporarily not collected.

issuer: Bank of China
document: Exchange rate board, English page, published 2026/11/11 11:00:03
plain_english_ours: U.S. dollar per 100: buying 666.29, cash buying 666.29, selling 669.1, cash selling 669.1, middle 671.91.

issuer: Internal Revenue Service
document: Streamlined filing compliance procedures
quote: Non-willful conduct is conduct that is due to negligence, inadvertence, or mistake or conduct that is the result of a good faith misunderstanding of the requirements of the law […] If the IRS has initiated a civil examination of taxpayer's returns for any taxable year, regardless of whether the examination relates to undisclosed foreign financial assets, the taxpayer will not be eligible to use the streamlined procedures.
plain_english_ours: The streamlined procedures need a certification that the failure was not willful, and close once the IRS has opened an examination of any year.

issuer: Internal Revenue Service
document: U.S. taxpayers residing outside the United States (Streamlined Foreign Offshore Procedures)
quote: in any one or more of the most recent three years for which the U.S. tax return due date (or properly applied for extended due date) has passed, the individual did not have a U.S. abode and the individual was physically outside the United States for at least 330 full days. […] (1) for each of the most recent 3 years for which the U.S. tax return due date (or properly applied for extended due date) has passed, file delinquent or amended tax returns, together with all required information returns (e.g., Forms 3520, 5471, and 8938) and (2) for each of the most recent 6 years for which the FBAR due date has passed, file any delinquent FBARs […] will not be subject to failure-to-file and failure-to-pay penalties, accuracy-related penalties, information return penalties, or FBAR penalties.
plain_english_ours: Living abroad test: no U.S. abode and 330 full days outside the U.S. in at least one of the last three years. File three years of returns and six years of FBARs and pay the tax and interest. No penalties.

issuer: Internal Revenue Service
document: U.S. taxpayers residing in the United States (Streamlined Domestic Offshore Procedures)
quote: have previously filed a U.S. tax return (if required) for each of the most recent 3 years for which the U.S. tax return due date (or properly applied for extended due date) has passed […] The Title 26 miscellaneous offshore penalty is equal to 5 percent of the highest aggregate balance/value of the taxpayer’s foreign financial assets that are subject to the miscellaneous offshore penalty during the years in the covered tax return period and the covered FBAR period. […] will be subject only to the Title 26 miscellaneous offshore penalty and will not be subject to accuracy-related penalties, information return penalties, or FBAR penalties.
plain_english_ours: For people living in the U.S. who filed returns for the last three years: amend three years, file six years of FBARs, pay tax, interest and a single penalty of 5% of the highest year-end total of the unreported foreign assets. No other penalties.

issuer: Taxpayer Advocate Service (an independent organization within the IRS)
document: Foreign Bank and Financial Accounts (FBAR)
quote: The IRS won’t impose a penalty for failure to file delinquent FBARs if you reported your foreign income properly and paid any associated taxes on your U.S. tax return and it hasn’t already contacted you about an audit or request for delinquent returns for the years covered by the delinquent FBARs.
plain_english_ours: Late FBARs carry no penalty if the foreign income was reported and taxed and the IRS has not already been in touch about those years.

issuer: Internal Revenue Service
document: Delinquent international information return submission procedures
quote: should file the delinquent information returns through normal filing procedures. Penalties may be assessed in accordance with existing procedures.
plain_english_ours: Other late international forms are filed the normal way, with a reasonable-cause statement if one applies; penalties may still be assessed.

issuer: Internal Revenue Service
document: IRS Criminal Investigation Voluntary Disclosure Practice
quote: If you have willfully failed to comply with tax or tax-related obligations, submitting a voluntary disclosure may be a means to resolve your non-compliance and limit exposure to criminal prosecution. […] Review the news release, issued on Dec. 22, 2025, announcing a 90-day comment period on the Voluntary Disclosure Practice proposal. […] For amended returns, a 20 percent accuracy-related penalty applies to each year.
plain_english_ours: The route for willful cases. Its penalty terms were put out for public comment on 22 December 2025; the page describes the proposed terms, not final ones.

issuer: Internal Revenue Service
document: Options available for U.S. taxpayers with undisclosed foreign financial assets
quote: the IRS offers the following options for addressing previous failures to comply with U.S. tax and information return obligations with respect to those investments: IRS Criminal Investigation Voluntary Disclosure Practice; Streamlined Filing Compliance Procedures; and Delinquent international information return submission procedures.
plain_english_ours: The IRS lists three options: voluntary disclosure, the streamlined procedures, and the late information-return procedure.

issuer: Financial Crimes Enforcement Network, in the Electronic Code of Federal Regulations
document: 31 CFR 1010.821, Table 1 (page stated: up to date as of 11/09/2026)
quote: Maximum penalty amounts or range of minimum and maximum penalty amounts for penalties assessed on or after January 17, 2025 […] 31 U.S.C. 5321(a)(5)(B)(i) | Foreign Financial Agency Transaction—Non-Willful Violation of Transaction | 10,000 | 16,536 […] 31 U.S.C. 5321(a)(5)(C)(i)(I) | Foreign Financial Agency Transaction—Willful Violation of Transaction | 100,000 | 165,353
plain_english_ours: Inflation-adjusted FBAR ceilings for penalties assessed on or after 17 January 2025: $16,536 for a non-willful violation, $165,353 as the fixed-dollar ceiling for a willful one.

issuer: U.S. Government Publishing Office (United States Code)
quote: (ii) Reasonable cause exception.—No penalty shall be imposed under subparagraph (A) with respect to any violation if— (I) such violation was due to reasonable cause, and (II) the amount of the transaction or the balance in the account at the time of the transaction was properly reported. […] (i) the maximum penalty under subparagraph (B)(i) shall be increased to the greater of— (I) $100,000, or (II) 50 percent of the amount determined under subparagraph (D) […] in the case of a violation involving a failure to report the existence of an account or any identifying information required to be provided with respect to an account, the balance in the account at the time of the violation. […] (1) Assessments.—The Secretary of the Treasury may assess a civil penalty under subsection (a) at any time before the end of the 6-year period beginning on the date of the transaction with respect to which the penalty is assessed.
plain_english_ours: No non-willful penalty where there was reasonable cause and the balance was properly reported. A willful violation is capped at the greater of the fixed dollar amount or 50% of the account balance at the time of the violation. Penalties may be assessed for six years.

issuer: Supreme Court of the United States
document: Bittner v. United States, No. 21-1195, decided 28 February 2023
quote: The BSA’s $10,000 maximum penalty for the nonwillful failure to file a compliant report accrues on a per-report, not a per-account, basis.
plain_english_ours: The non-willful FBAR penalty is counted once per annual report, not once per account.

issuer: Internal Revenue Service
document: Publication 514, Foreign Tax Credit for Individuals (current edition)
quote: If you use the cash method of accounting, you can claim the credit only in the year in which you pay the tax. […] You make the choice by checking the “Accrued” box in Part II of Form 1116 on a timely filed original return. You cannot make this choice on an amended return. Once you make that choice, you must follow it in all later years and take a credit for foreign taxes in the year they accrue. […] If, because of the limit on the credit, you cannot use the full amount of qualified foreign taxes paid or accrued in the tax year, you are allowed a 1-year carryback and then a 10-year carryover of the unused foreign taxes. […] If you pay more foreign tax than you originally claimed a credit for, you have 10 years to file a claim for refund of U.S. taxes.
plain_english_ours: A cash-method taxpayer credits foreign tax in the year it is paid. Choosing the year the tax accrued is possible only on a timely original return and then binds later years. There is a limit; unused credit goes back one year and forward ten. A refund claim for extra foreign tax paid can be made for ten years.

issuer: Internal Revenue Service
document: Failure to file penalty
quote: The penalty is 5% of the tax due (less any tax paid on time and available credits) for each month or partial month the return is late. The penalty accrues up to a maximum of 25%. […] the failure to file penalty is reduced by the amount of the failure to pay penalty (0.5% for each month).
plain_english_ours: Late filing: 5% of the unpaid tax per month, up to 25%. Late payment: 0.5% per month.

issuer: Internal Revenue Service
document: Accuracy-related penalty
quote: In cases of substantial understatement, the accuracy-related penalty is 20% of the portion of the underpayment of tax.
plain_english_ours: Understating tax substantially: 20% of the underpaid tax.

issuer: Internal Revenue Service
document: Quarterly interest rates
quote: Current year 2026 quarterly interest rates […] Underpayment (corporate and non-corporate) | 7% | 7% | 6% | 7% […] 2025 […] Underpayment (corporate and non-corporate) | 7% | 7% | 7% | 7% […] 2024 […] Underpayment (corporate and non-corporate) | 8% | 8% | 8% | 8%

issuer: Internal Revenue Service
document: Interest
quote: Tax is due on the return filing date; extensions to file do not extend the date for payment of the tax. […] Interest will continue to accrue daily on any amount not paid, including on both penalties and interest.
plain_english_ours: Interest runs from the original due date and accrues daily, on tax, penalties and earlier interest.

issuer: U.S. Government Publishing Office (United States Code)
quote: the amount of any tax imposed by this title shall be assessed within 3 years after the return was filed […] In the case of failure to file a return, the tax may be assessed, or a proceeding in court for the collection of such tax may be begun without assessment, at any time. […] (II) is in excess of $5,000, the tax may be assessed, or a proceeding in court for collection of such tax may be begun without assessment, at any time within 6 years after the return was filed.
plain_english_ours: Tax can be assessed for three years after a return is filed; at any time if no return was filed; for six years if more than $5,000 of income from reportable foreign assets was left out.

issuer: Internal Revenue Service
document: Instructions for Form 1040 (2025), Foreign-Source Income
quote: You must report unearned income, such as interest, dividends, and pensions, from sources outside the United States unless exempt by law or a tax treaty. You must also report earned income, such as wages and tips, from sources outside the United States. […] You must complete Part III of Schedule B if you: Had a foreign account;
plain_english_ours: Interest, dividends, wages and other income from outside the U.S. go on the return. A foreign account means completing Schedule B, Part III.

issuer: Internal Revenue Service
document: Internal Revenue Manual 4.63.3
quote: Form 14653 Certification by U.S. Person Residing Outside of the United States for Streamlined Foreign Offshore Procedures […] Form 14654 Certification by U.S. Person Residing in the United States for Streamlined Domestic Offshore Procedures […] A civil fraud penalty or fraudulent failure to file penalty, under IRC 6663 or IRC 6651(f), respectively, will apply to at least one year of every voluntary disclosure.
plain_english_ours: The two streamlined certification forms, and the existing voluntary-disclosure rule that a fraud penalty applies to at least one year.

issuer: Internal Revenue Service
document: Report of Foreign Bank and Financial Accounts (FBAR)
quote: the aggregate value of those foreign financial accounts exceeded $10,000 at any time during the calendar year reported. […] The FBAR is an annual report, due April 15 following the calendar year reported. You’re allowed an automatic extension to October 15
plain_english_ours: An FBAR is required when the foreign accounts together exceeded $10,000 at any time in the year. Due 15 April, automatically extended to 15 October.

issuer: Internal Revenue Service
document: Publication 514, Foreign Tax Credit for Individuals (2023 edition)
quote: Amounts paid to a foreign government to satisfy a liability for interest, fines, penalties, or any similar obligation are not taxes and do not qualify for the credit.
plain_english_ours: Interest, fines and penalties paid to a foreign government are not creditable. The closing words of this sentence also appear in the current edition's text.
